pictures.name: CMT1-Tax-Booth
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A busy lakeside road in first-century Capernaum, the Sea of Galilee glittering behind black basalt houses. In the middle, Matthew, a tax collector of about thirty-five with a neat black beard, in a fine dark green robe with a gold-trimmed sash, sits at a low wooden table piled with coins and a wax tablet, a scale beside him. Fishermen and farmers pass by glaring at him or turning their faces away. Warm gold morning light, deep blue shadows under an awning. Isolation in a crowd. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CMT2-The-Look
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same tax table by the lake, seen over the shoulder of a man in a plain cream robe with a dark brown outer cloak, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, who stands before the table. In the middle, Matthew, a tax collector of about thirty-five with a neat black beard, in a fine dark green robe with a gold-trimmed sash, looks up from his coins, startled, his hand frozen over the money, his face opening in disbelief at being looked at kindly. Gold light falls on Matthew’s face, deep blue shade under the awning. Mercy, a moment that changes a life. No text, no letters, no logos.

Down the road, in the middle distance, Matthew, a tax collector of about thirty-five with a neat black beard, in a fine dark green robe with a gold-trimmed sash, walks away beside a man in a plain cream robe with a dark brown outer cloak, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, both small figures seen from behind, heading toward the lake. Gold sunlight on the scattered coins in the foreground, deep blue lake. Freedom, a door opening. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CMT4-Dinner-Sinners
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A lamp-lit courtyard of a fine house in Capernaum at evening, a long low table crowded with bread, fish and wine. In the middle, Matthew, a tax collector of about thirty-five with a neat black beard, in a fine dark green robe with a gold-trimmed sash, laughs as he passes bread to rough-looking guests: tax collectors in rich robes, a weary woman in a faded veil, poor laborers. a man in a plain cream robe with a dark brown outer cloak, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, sits among them at the near end of the table, his back to us. In the doorway two scholarly men in fine plain robes frown and whisper. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue night. Welcome, joy, scandal. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CMT5-Bede-Monk
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. An Anglo-Saxon monastery scriptorium in northern England, around 730 AD: stone walls, a small arched window onto a grey sea. In the middle, Bede, an elderly monk with a white tonsured fringe of hair in a black Benedictine habit, sits at a slanted wooden desk writing with a quill on a large parchment page, a candle beside him, looking up thoughtfully as if seeing the scene he writes about. Deep blue shadows, warm gold candlelight. Wisdom, quiet devotion. The page shows only blurred lines, no readable writing. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CMT6-Today-Young-Man
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Buenos Aires, a spring morning in 1953: the grand pale facade and dome of a city basilica on a tree-lined street, old cars parked along the curb. In the middle, a slim teenage boy in a 1950s jacket and trousers, seen from behind, his face not visible, climbs the church steps toward the open doors, where warm gold candlelight glows inside. Soft gold morning light, deep blue shade under the jacaranda trees. A quiet turning point. No text, no letters, no logos.
